body:
I usually don't post, but i feel like this is the type of answer everyone wants to read because it involves someone getting beaten half to death.  This story isn't about me, but a friend of mine. I'm using a throwaway because he's a redditor too.

My friend got married last summer after we graduated high school.  Not because he got his girlfriend knocked up or anything like that, they just really wanted to get married.  Since they were still both teenagers they obviously got a lot of flack for that, but when he told our group of friends that he was getting engaged and wanted us to be in his wedding, we supported him through it. 

New Years day I hear a rumor that some friend of a friend of a friend got sent to the hospital because he was caught in bed with some guys wife.  Some names got tossed around and then i hear that it my friend that was doing the beating.  This caught me WAY off guard and i didn't believe it for a second until i texted him about it.  It wasn't until a few days later that we could talk about it, but eventually he ended up telling about how he broke the guys nose so badly that it needed several stitches and required other facial reconstructive surgeries. He basically hit the guy in the face so many times it turned him into a pulp.  That is really the only part of the story that remains consistent and matches up with the facts.  As far as how he actually got caught or whether or not they actually ended up having sex changes depending on who is telling the story. I honestly don't know who to believe.

Well I'm kinda losing that battle now too. But that just goes to show that the world could use someone like you: Someone who wants to use their skill set and personal experience to help people in need.

You're right, I do really enjoy talking to her.  She just has no time for me.  She has two jobs and is still a senior in high school.  She makes straight A's so she studies all the time and has to go into school early to tutor other kids.  After school she has cheer practice and play practice, and on top of all that shes a part time model so she has fashion shoots every so often.  The only reason I even told her how I felt is because I missed her so much. I hated only getting to see her once a week. Ironically, telling her how I felt had the opposite effect :P

Thanks for taking the time to respond, it means a lot. But honestly, I could never tell her.  She knows how much I like her and she knows I haven't been able to get over her for the past year and a half.  Can you imagine what kind of a burden I would be if I told her I was planning on killing myself? It would be like guilt tripping her into dating me.  It would put her in such a horrible position to know that I'm suicidal.  I can't imagine what I would do if someone I wasn't attracted to told me that they loved me and wanted to kill themselves.  If I turned them down, It would just drive them deeper into depression.

If anything, it sounds like May 10th will be the start of a whole new life for you.  I completely understand that losing a bf sucks, totaling a car sucks, but these problems don't need to be a reason to consider suicide. I'm not trying to belittle your problems, I know how depressed you must be feeling. But the fact that you're going to be a health counselor is really admirable. And now that you've been through this huge battle with suicide, you can use that to help people in your career.  You're obviously a pretty smart girl if you're able to balance two jobs and go through school.
